text: Built a Python FastAPI task API with tenant-scoped Postgres queries and integration tests. Implemented session authentication and documented the deployment procedure for the Cedar Tasks demonstration project.
Built a TypeScript React dashboard with responsive layouts, keyboard navigation and filterable charts. Used Next.js routes and typed API responses for the Harbor Dashboard demonstration project.
Implemented Python retrieval augmented generation using Qdrant vector search and evidence citations. Evaluated retrieval on a small original test corpus for the Maple Search demonstration project.
Created SQL reporting models and Python data validation checks for the Willow Reports demonstration project. Documented dbt transformations and reconciled source totals against dashboard reports.
